items.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Taps Envision Energy To Cut Supply Chain Emissions With Low Carbon Ammonia
items.summary: PepsiCo APAC has entered an environmental attribute agreement with Envision Energy tied to low carbon ammonia use in its agricultural supply chain. The arrangement enables PepsiCo to acquire and apply low carbon ammonia environmental attribute certificates to support its Scope 3 emissions targets from 2026 to 2030.
